## SECTION 2: Executive Overview & Value Proposition
Noryvex is a done-for-you (DFY) **AI automation agency** specializing in custom 24/7 AI voice receptionists and workflow automation for US dental clinics, healthcare practices, and service businesses.
- **Free Custom Demo First**: Noryvex builds a working AI voice receptionist prototype customized with the client's real business name, services, opening hours, and FAQs within 48 hours at zero cost. Clients test the live voice AI before paying anything.
- **100% Managed Engineering**: Unlike self-serve SaaS tools that force clinic owners to configure complex prompt flows or dashboards, Muhammad Razi and the Noryvex engineering team design, integrate, test, and manage the entire system end-to-end.
- **Sub-500ms Voice Latency**: Engineered on frontier LLMs (OpenAI GPT-4o, Groq, Claude) combined with ultra-low-latency speech synthesis (ElevenLabs, Vapi, Twilio) for natural, human-grade phone conversations.

---

## SECTION 3: Core Artificial Intelligence & Automation Solutions

### 1. 24/7 Inbound AI Voice Receptionists
Answers every inbound, peak-hour overflow, lunch-break, and after-hours phone call instantly in a warm, natural human voice. Eliminates voicemail drop-offs and missed patient revenue.

### 2. Clinic & Business FAQ Automation
Custom-trained on practice-specific knowledge: opening hours, location & parking, dental treatments (implants, Invisalign, whitening, root canals, pediatric dentistry), pricing guidance, and insurance coverage (PPO, Delta Dental, Cigna, MetLife, etc.).

### 3. Automated Appointment Booking & Patient Intake
Captures caller name, phone number, new vs. existing patient status, reason for visit, and preferred appointment dates/times, then routes structured booking requests directly to the front desk or calendar.

### 4. Practice Management System (PMS) & CRM Workflow Sync
Integrates with major dental and business software platforms:
- Dental PMS: Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Curve Dental
- Calendars & CRMs: Google Calendar, Calendly, HubSpot, Salesforce, Notion, Airtable, Slack, Zapier

### 5. Clinical Emergency Call Triage
Recognizes urgent dental symptoms (severe toothache, facial swelling, trauma, knocked-out tooth, uncontrolled bleeding) and immediately escalates or routes callers to the on-call dentist according to practice protocols.

### 6. Custom AI Software, Web Applications & Business Automation
Beyond voice AI, Noryvex designs and builds bespoke web applications, patient intake portals, internal analytics dashboards, and multi-step LLM workflow automations.

---

## SECTION 4: HIPAA Compliance & Enterprise Security
- **Business Associate Agreements (BAAs)**: Noryvex signs standard HIPAA BAAs with all US dental and healthcare clients.
- **End-to-End Encryption**: TLS 1.3 encryption in transit and AES-256 encryption at rest across all voice streams, transcripts, and databases.
- **Zero Public AI Training**: Patient call audio and transcripts are strictly isolated and never used to train public AI models.
- **US Cloud Infrastructure**: Hosted on secure, low-latency US cloud data centers with dedicated US local or toll-free phone numbers in all 50 states.
